title: Banks Act Directive D2/2021 — Matters related to the issuance of additional tier 1 capital instruments that contain contingent 'must-pay' clauses
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Matters related to the issuance of additional tier 1 capital instruments that contain contingent 'must-pay' clauses.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Matters related to the issuance of additional tier 1 capital instruments that contain contingent 'must-pay' clauses.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Matters related to the issuance of additional tier 1 capital instruments that contain contingent 'must-pay' clauses. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
